errors.text: The proposed Mg-Al-Zn-Sc-Y composition does not reconstruct the MgAlTiVFeCo BCC powder system.
The claimed optimum of 920 °C contradicts the target optimum of 1000 °C and excludes the decisive 1000 °C comparison from the falsification experiment.

At 920 °C, elemental Mg is far above its melting point and highly volatile under high vacuum; describing only a transient grain-boundary liquid and stable solid-state densification is physically implausible without strong containment or vapor-pressure control.
The proposed Mg-Sc-Y solid solution and Mg17Sc2/Mg24Y5 precipitate pathway is unsupported by phase-analysis or thermodynamic evidence.
The mechanism omits the target oxide barrier phases, passive-film formation, chloride-blocking behavior, and biphasic parabolic oxidation kinetics.
All quantitative baseline, density, volatility, oxidation, and corrosion claims are uncited.
